candidates.title: MegaScale-Infer: Serving Mixture-of-Experts at Scale with Disaggregated Expert Parallelism
candidates.reason: CrossPoolの直接的基盤で、attentionとFFNを物理分離するdisaggregated expert parallelism、ping-pong pipeline、GPU-CPU copy/syncを避けるM2N通信を提案。per-GPU throughput最大1.90倍、heterogeneous deploymentのcost効率改善を示すSIGCOMM 2025系の重要基盤論文で、未収録なら優先補完価値が高い。
